lead: A `Core\Attributes` retrieval probe proves nothing about `$member` unless the target itself carries a matching attribute.
body: A computed `$member` was being ignored rather than folded to the empty result, and a fixture whose class carries no matching literal prints `null` under either behaviour, so the first probe read as agreement with `rule:attributes/structural-retrieval`. Attach a matching literal to the class *and* to the member before asserting anything about `$member`, the way `tests/conformance/lang/attributes-retrieval-answers-by-shape-in-declaration-order.nvst` does.
